name: desktop-readonly-field-treatment
goal: Make every read-only game view field visibly immutable while retaining navigation

evidence: Visual review 4 rejects the readonly catalog state at all three viewports: only Dimension looks disabled; title and art direction look editable despite readonly attributes.

Existing standardized cases checked the readonly attribute and dimension picker but not the text fields painted treatment or focusability. Strengthen those same three post-capture cases to require disabled, muted fields and a visible read-only label.
